description: Use this when a person wants private healthcare from The Wellness and has not named a blood test, a scan or a specialist. It covers a private GP in person, by video or by phone, a doctor at a home or hotel, health assessments, IV therapy, longevity, psychiatry and ADHD, dermatology, dentistry and aesthetics, in London, Dubai, Beverly Hills, New York, Miami, Singapore, Hong Kong, Paris, Monaco, San Francisco, Tokyo, Sydney, Milan, Riyadh and Jeddah. Returns each service with its fee in local currency, its length and how it is booked. Does not diagnose, triage or give medical advice. Do not use it for emergencies.

city.description: Where the person wants to be seen. Leave it out to use where they are, or London.

max_fee.description: Optional highest fee, in the city's own currency.

mode.description: How they want to be seen. clinic, home (home, hotel or office), video or phone.

query.description: What the person wants, in their words, e.g. "same day GP", "IV drip", "ADHD assessment".
